visual_connections.description: Sends requests from the iOS app to the Gateway inside EKS.
Gateway routes media-related traffic to the Media service.
Gateway routes messaging traffic to the Messaging Connection Service (MCS).
The Media service sends media content through CloudFront.
CloudFront retrieves and stores static media content from and to Amazon S3.
The Media service interacts with Friend Graph to determine relationships.
MCS establishes connections and pushes messages back up to the Android client.
MCS looks up active connections and server mappings in ElastiCache.
MCS interacts with Snap DB to update metadata.
Snap DB reads and writes persistent metadata from and to Amazon DynamoDB.
